data.name: List_Description
data.value: Lists the folders and files of a folder on this computer. Only the folders the user allowed can be read. Call it without a path to get the list of allowed folders.

data.name: List_Path
data.value: Absolute path of the folder. Omit it to get the allowed folders.

data.name: Read_Description
data.value: Reads the text of a file inside a folder the user allowed. Long files come in parts: call again with 'start' set to the 'next_start' of the previous result.

data.name: Read_Start
data.value: Position of the first character to read, 0 by default.
